title: abies grandis var. lowiana
intro: Abies grandis var. lowiana, commonly known as Incense Cedar or Low's Incense Cedar, is a variety of tree native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Abies grandis var. lowiana include its ability to soothe respiratory issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, particularly alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
